Former England defender on Final Score 
 Chelsea have really struggled with Leeds' physicality, I think it's an example here. I can't tell you how good a finish that is from Okafor, he strikes with his laces. 
 Chelsea are struggling with Leeds system, they haven't been winning first or second balls today.
